tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All tested respiratory viruses (influenza A/B, RSV, parainfluenza 1-3, rhinovirus, human metapneumovirus, adenovirus) were not detected in the respiratory specimen. These results suggest no evidence of acute infection with these common respiratory viruses at the time of testing. Correlate with clinical findings for further evaluation.
